requirements.description: Compustat annual EPS and beginning-of-fiscal-year price, plus the fiscal-year and SIC fields needed for the survivor sample and utility exclusion.

required_coverage.population: The 896-firm constant panel described as existing from 1968 through 1998, with earlier firm-year observations used in Table 5; regulated utilities excluded
required_coverage.detail: The table’s full time span is 1950–1998. EPS/P(t−1) requires prior-year price data for 1949. The paper does not identify a specific Compustat EPS item or basic/diluted and extraordinary-item convention.

routes.mapping_notes: Compustat annual EPS and fiscal price columns are present; the paper does not specify which EPS product/code or precise fiscal-price item generated its EPS measure.
routes.coverage_notes: A bounded probe verifies access and columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this resource and required period/population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coordinator coverage confirmation establishes 1949–1998 annual coverage for the 896-firm survivor cohort. The current field proof is not the paper’s 1999 vintage.

requirements.description: CRSP monthly firm returns required for fiscal-year return windows from nine months before through three months after fiscal year-end.

required_coverage.population: CRSP-linked securities of the 896 Compustat constant-sample firms for fiscal years 1950–1998
required_coverage.detail: For the first 1950 observation, the nine-month lookback requires 1949 CRSP months; for the final 1998 observation, the three-month lead can require 1999 months.

routes.mapping_notes: Monthly CRSP firm return and date fields are present. Monthly compounding and fiscal-year-end alignment are construction steps from the stated window.
routes.coverage_notes: A bounded probe verifies access and columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this resource and required period/population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coordinator coverage confirmation establishes full 1949–1999 monthly coverage for all historical links in the constant cohort.

requirements.description: Date-valid historical mapping from Compustat GVKEY firm-years to CRSP PERMNO securities.

required_coverage.population: All firm-years and securities in the 896-firm constant panel and the CRSP return windows
required_coverage.detail: Use CCM link dates, link type and primary-link markers to select a security valid at each return observation; the paper does not state exact CCM link-selection flags.

routes.mapping_notes: Probe confirms GVKEY/PERMNO keys and link date bounds. The paper’s link selection criteria are not documented.
routes.coverage_notes: A bounded probe verifies access and columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this resource and required period/population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coordinator coverage confirmation verifies link coverage for 1949–1999 and the survivor cohort.

requirements.description: Reconstruct the 896-firm survivor constant panel, exclude regulated utilities, and preserve the overall and nine calendar subperiod fits.

required_coverage.population: Firms existing from 1968 through 1998, with pre-1968 firm-year history used in the table
required_coverage.detail: Table 5 displays observations back to 1950 even though the firm cohort is defined by survival through 1968–1998. Keep this source-defined cohort and its earlier history.

routes.mapping_notes: Fields support fiscal-year cohort construction and SIC-based utility exclusion; coverage remains unverified.
routes.coverage_notes: A bounded probe verifies access and columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this resource and required period/population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The 896-firm cohort and historical observations require complete Compustat population coverage not established by a bounded probe.

requirements.description: Annual trimming of the most extreme 1 percent of EPS/P observations reported in the Table 5 note.

required_coverage.population: Within each table estimation sample and year
required_coverage.detail: The source note reports truncation of annual extremes but does not resolve the quantile convention or whether the 1 percent is one- or two-sided.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The trimming direction/convention is not fully specified by the source extraction and no exact threshold population is identified.
